::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Distinct from TEL's 2024 equipment-supply MoU with Tata (which stays as a milestone on Tata's own facility page) — this is TEL's own India footprint: a Bengaluru software/equipment-design R&D centre plus a Gujarat training centre backed by Japan's METI to build a fab-engineer talent pipeline. No investment figure disclosed for either.
:::

## What does this facility supply?

Software development, equipment design and simulation for semiconductor manufacturing tools; separately, engineer training for fab and equipment maintenance roles.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Equipment Manufacturer |
| **Parent Company** | Tokyo Electron Limited (Japan) |
| **Location** | Bengaluru, Karnataka |
| **Investment** | Not disclosed |
| **Status** | Announced |
| **Supplies** | General / not tied to one facility |

## Project Timeline

- **10 Sep 2025** — Tokyo Electron announces a Bengaluru development centre focused on software, simulation, and equipment design for semiconductor manufacturing
- **20 Sep 2026** — Tokyo Electron confirms a semiconductor training centre in Gujarat, opening 2027, backed by Japan's METI
